records.excerpt: At the event the technology giant's chief executive Lei Jun said the standard SU7 model would be priced at 215,900 yuan ($29,872; £23,663) and the Max version would cost 299,900 yuan.
records.statement: BBC报道雷军在发布会上宣布SU7标准版售价215900元，Max版299900元。这里只登记媒体对发布会定价的报道，不证明销量或盈利。

records.excerpt: The firm says it got over 50,000 orders within the first 27 minutes of sales.
records.statement: BBC转述小米称开售前27分钟订单超过5万；是公司订单声明经媒体转述，不等于交付量，也不是独立交叉验证。
